findings.summary: No single declaration states Proposition A.4; its clauses are split over exists_prepared, preserves_specification, ReservedPatches lemmas and true_from_transition. Premise correct; every lemma is universal in the profile, so assembly is routine. Encoding choice, not a content gap.
No theorem states that stage boundaries divided by X_R are independent of X_R and η. True by definition: every boundary is radius XR c = XR·exp c, with the clock c computed from F.data alone.

exists_prepared (Nonempty PreparedProfile) drops the order (A.6): it exposes 2 ≤ P, λ ≤ 1/120, wait = 60 log(1/λ), 2h < λ, h ≤ 1/1000, but not P_* > e^{T_d} or the h cap. The ordered theorems state the order.

Patch offsets are measured from pulseStart = holdStart + wait, so the origin is the start of the l = −λ hold. Read strictly, p. 129 puts the stage origin one unit earlier, at the transition start. Both placements satisfy A.4's patch clause.

The cone is stated in log-clock coordinates with normalized histories (H = e^{y/2}E, no √2 factors), with p_{s,2} written as p_{s,1}·N_s/(E·Q_s) and an extra conjunct Q_s > 0. It implies (4.21); Lean is stronger here.
